welcome.title: Welcome to PhysioTrack!
welcome.subtitle: Combine physical therapy exercises with the peace of meditation using PhysioTrack. Feel stronger at every step with personalized programs.

onboarding.introSubtitle: Discover personalized physical therapy and meditation routines for a healthier you.

progress.aboutDesc: Tell us who this plan is for and we will personalize the experience from the first screen.
progress.focusDesc: Choose where you want the most support so your exercise program feels immediately relevant.
progress.goalsDesc: Pick a routine that feels achievable and keeps your recovery momentum visible every day.

step1.title: About you
step1.text: Share the basics so your home plan feels personal from the start.
step1.ageText: This helps us present a plan that feels better matched to your pace and comfort level.

step2.title: Choose your focus
step2.text: We'll bring the most relevant exercise program to the top of your home screen.

step3.title: Set your weekly rhythm
step3.text: These goals power the bars and circles on your dashboard.
step3.weeklyTitle: How often do you want to move?
step3.weeklyText: Pick a weekly pace that feels realistic enough to stay consistent.
step3.stepsText: A daily walking target helps you keep progress visible beyond the exercise sessions.

onboarding.footerHint: You can update these preferences later from your profile.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue your guided exercises, restore your routine, and keep your recovery streak moving.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Your onboarding profile is ready. Add your account details to save your plan and continue with email verification.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your email address.
verifyEmail.resendSuccess: A new verification code has been sent.
